issues.note: Catalog already merges these Let me and Would you like to candidates across groups three and eight. Do not create self-aliases or duplicate lessons.
Legacy formula strings are retained in form. reviewed_form broadens overly restrictive time-only formulas to include the actual valid examples.
No fixed numerical frequency percentages are asserted. Usually position is described as usual, not the sole grammatical position.
What is this word? is translated as identification of the word, not automatically as What does this word mean?

Same modal grammar, different first-person planning versus second-person advice functions. Kept as requested catalog candidates with an explicit family link; primary editor may combine them into one lesson with variants.
